one_line: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO amid leadership turmoil, while OpenAI and Anthropic launched new AI agent payment and meeting tools.

themes.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO
themes.text: Nvidia's board is seeking a CEO search firm after Jensen Huang resigned following disclosures about his relationship with Alice Huang. The departure has cast uncertainty over Nvidia's lending consortium, startup investments, and upcoming US-China policy talks.

themes.title: New AI tools support shopping and meetings
themes.text: OpenAI introduced the ChatGPT Wallet for agent shopping, while Amazon drafted a World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents. Additionally, Anthropic launched Claude Meetings to join video calls and take notes.
